content: The World Health Organization (WHO) published guidelines in 2010 regarding sodium intake for adults and children, emphasizing its importance in health management. Another 2012 report by WHO focused on the impact of reduced sodium consumption on cardiovascular diseases, coronary heart disease, and stroke. Vasan RS discussed biomarkers of cardiovascular disease, focusing on their molecular basis and practical applications. McPherson K, Britton A, and Causer L estimated the impact of changes in risk factors on coronary heart disease, as reported by the National Heart Forum in 2002. The United States Department of Agriculture and the Food and Agricultural Organization (FAO) of the United Nations have also contributed to the understanding of dietary sodium and its health implications. Wu Leung W provided a comprehensive food composition guide for use in Africa, published jointly by FAO and the US Department of Health, Education, and Welfare in 1968. Cashel K, English R, and Lewis J compiled a detailed composition of foods in Australia, published by the Nutrition Section of the Department of Community Services and Health in 1989.
